69: /// Creates ExternalCommand from a call
70: pub fn create_external_command(
71:     engine_state: &EngineState,
72:     stack: &mut Stack,
73:     call: &Call,
74: ) -> Result<ExternalCommand, ShellError> {
75:     let name: Spanned<String> = call.req(engine_state, stack, 0)?;
76: 
77:     // Translate environment variables from Values to Strings
78:     let env_vars_str = env_to_strings(engine_state, stack)?;
79: 
80:     fn value_as_spanned(value: Value) -> Result<Spanned<String>, ShellError> {
81:         let span = value.span();
82: 
83:         value
84:             .coerce_string()
85:             .map(|item| Spanned { item, span })
86:             .map_err(|_| ShellError::ExternalCommand {
87:                 label: format!("Cannot convert {} to a string", value.get_type()),
88:                 help: "All arguments to an external command need to be string-compatible".into(),
89:                 span,
90:             })
91:     }
92: 
93:     let eval_expression = get_eval_expression(engine_state);
94: 
95:     let mut spanned_args = vec![];
96:     let mut arg_keep_raw = vec![];
97:     for (arg, spread) in call.rest_iter(1) {
98:         match eval_expression(engine_state, stack, arg)? {
99:             Value::List { vals, .. } => {
100:                 if spread {
101:                     // turn all the strings in the array into params.
102:                     // Example: one_arg may be something like ["ls" "-a"]
103:                     // convert it to "ls" "-a"
104:                     for v in vals {
105:                         spanned_args.push(value_as_spanned(v)?);
106:                         // for arguments in list, it's always treated as a whole arguments
107:                         arg_keep_raw.push(true);
108:                     }
109:                 } else {
110:                     return Err(ShellError::CannotPassListToExternal {
111:                         arg: String::from_utf8_lossy(engine_state.get_span_contents(arg.span))
112:                             .into(),
113:                         span: arg.span,
114:                     });
115:                 }
116:             }
117:             val => {
118:                 if spread {
119:                     return Err(ShellError::CannotSpreadAsList { span: arg.span });
120:                 } else {
121:                     spanned_args.push(value_as_spanned(val)?);
122:                     match arg.expr {
123:                         // refer to `parse_dollar_expr` function
124:                         // the expression type of $variable_name, $"($variable_name)"
125:                         // will be Expr::StringInterpolation, Expr::FullCellPath
126:                         Expr::StringInterpolation(_) | Expr::FullCellPath(_) => {
127:                             arg_keep_raw.push(true)
128:                         }
129:                         _ => arg_keep_raw.push(false),
130:                     }
131:                 }
132:             }
133:         }
134:     }
135: 
136:     Ok(ExternalCommand::assemble(
137:         name,
138:         spanned_args,
139:         arg_keep_raw,
140:         stack.stdout().clone(),
141:         stack.stderr().clone(),
142:         env_vars_str,
143:     ))
144: }
